name: fill-detached
why: the thread is detached: fill_in_thread returns before (or while) the thread writes, and the caller reads the vector without any synchronization.

name: run-all-one-after-the-other
why: the jobs run on the calling thread, in turn: jobs that wait for each other never finish.

name: run-all-does-not-catch
why: an exception that leaves a thread function calls std::terminate.

name: run-all-rethrows-the-last-error
why: the exception of the highest failing job is rethrown, not the lowest.

name: run-all-swallows-the-errors
why: the exceptions are caught in the threads, but never rethrown to the caller.

name: ticker-sleeps-for-the-period
why: sleep_for cannot be interrupted: the destructor waits for the whole period.

name: ticker-waits-before-the-first-tick
why: the first tick comes after one period instead of at once.

name: ticker-never-stops
why: the loop ignores the stop request: the destructor joins a thread that never ends.

name: ticker-without-a-wait
why: no wait at all: the callback is called as fast as the CPU allows.

name: ticker-thread-declared-too-early
why: the thread is a member declared BEFORE the mutex and the condition variable: they are destroyed while the thread may still use them.

name: detach-in-the-ticker
why: a detached thread is not joined: it may tick after the Ticker has gone (Clean tier and robust tests).
